caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass goblet with a scalloped rim, positioned centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The goblet consists of a round bowl with a thick band near the upper section, a short stem, and a wide, circular base. The artist has used careful shading to indicate the reflective and transparent qualities of the glass material. The drawing is created in pencil or a similar monochrome medium, and the artist's signature "Carl Boegherniss" appears in small letters below and to the right of the goblet. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the artwork.
title: Spoon Holder
